axis_ties: lower dimension wins; spread measured on frozen FP64 coordinates
sort_ties: ascending object ID; S10 lex keys (z_a,z_b,ID)
cyclic: parent depth modulo 8; root depth 0 uses PC1
radial: centroid sums FP64 in ascending object-ID order with sequential accumulate per coordinate; divide by parent size; squared radius separate multiply/add in dimension order 0..7
duplicates: keep all 12, including duplicate axis proposals; count exact partition-order duplicates
children: sort ascending, cut ten equal contiguous children
